result.markdown:
# Power Failure and Battery Exhaustion on Site S-TUN-015

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-TUN-015`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarms on the site fit the KPI onset, and changes, maintenance, and sibling sites were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-07 15:45 to 2026-09-07 19:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-07 14:11
- **Affected:** S-TUN-015

## Summary

A mains failure at site S-TUN-015 led to battery exhaustion and subsequent site down state.

Availability and traffic dropped to zero on site S-TUN-015 for approximately 3.8 hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-07 14:11: Mains failure alarm raised on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000147]
- 2026-09-07 15:44: Battery low alarm raised on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000150]
- 2026-09-07 15:45: Availability drop started on S-TUN-015 [ALR-0007]
- 2026-09-07 15:59: Critical site down alarm raised on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000151]
- 2026-09-07 19:19: All site alarms cleared on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000147, ALM-000150, ALM-000151]
- 2026-09-07 19:30: Availability alert ended on S-TUN-015 [ALR-0007]

## Evidence

- Availability dropped from 100 to 0 on site S-TUN-015 from 15:45 to 19:30. [ALR-0007]
- Mains failure occurred on site S-TUN-015 at 14:11 and cleared at 19:19. [ALM-000147]
- Neighboring sibling sites S-TUN-005 and S-TUN-016 experienced no alarms or KPI deviations. [T6, T7]
- No changes were recorded on S-TUN-015 or its parents between 14:00 and 20:00. [T4]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-TUN-015 or its parents between 14:00 and 20:00. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-TUN-015: confirmed. Mains failure and battery low alarms directly explain the site going down while sibling sites remained unaffected. [ALM-000147, ALM-000150, ALM-000151]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-C: rejected. Sibling sites sharing the same fiber link and aggregation router remained fully operational without any deviations. [T2, T6, T7]

## Ruled out

- T4: No changes were executed on the site or parent nodes during the incident window.
- T5: No maintenance windows were active on the site or its parents during the incident.
- T6: Sibling sites showed no alarms, ruling out a shared transport or core failure.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect the local power feed and mains supply at site S-TUN-015.
- Verify the backup battery health and recharge capacity at S-TUN-015.

## Sources

- `ALM-000147`: major MAINS_FAILURE on S-TUN-015, raised 2026-09-07 14:11, cleared 2026-09-07 19:19
- `ALM-000150`: major BATTERY_LOW on S-TUN-015, raised 2026-09-07 15:44, cleared 2026-09-07 19:19
